## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> List your notes, optionally filtered by status or tag. Status evergreen is the source notes set to repeat; it is not a tag. Use skip for pagination. Check hasMore in the response to know if more results exist.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max notes to return (default 20, max 50) Default `20`. |
| `skip` | `number` | No | Offset for pagination Default `0`. |
| `status` | `string` | No | Filter by note status. evergreen means source notes set to repeat. It is a status, not a tag. One of: `"draft"`, `"ready"`, `"scheduled"`, `"published"`, `"evergreen"`. |
| `tag` | `string` | No | Filter by category/tag name |
